q: Why measure resolution quality rather than deflection alone?
options: Keeping customers from humans can raise complaints and churn without solving problems
explain: Resolved, satisfied customers are the goal.

q: Where should refund limits be enforced?
explain: Instructions are requests; code is enforcement.

q: What did Moffatt v. Air Canada (2024) establish in practice?
options: Chatbots are not responsible for anything
A company can be held responsible for what its chatbot tells customers
explain: The tribunal held the airline liable.
